preserved_public_contract.name: real_bounded_tool_use
assertions: One explicit LangGraph Agent owns the run.
A Decision may select only injected read tools.
Every successful or failed tool result becomes a persisted Observation before replan or stop.
Tool rounds never exceed two and physical execution attempts never exceed six.
Repeated no-progress calls terminate.

preserved_public_contract.name: deterministic_authorization_boundary
assertions: The model can classify, select read tools and form typed candidates but cannot authorize mutation.
Proposal MCP is callable only by deterministic Policy.
Runtime effects require an independent human decision and transaction-time revalidation.

preserved_public_contract.name: tenant_safe_observation_and_effect
assertions: Trusted identity and tenant scope are not derived from message text or Provider output.
Read observations, proposals, approvals and effects remain tenant scoped.
Cross-tenant denial reveals no foreign resource existence and creates zero action.

preserved_public_contract.name: traceable_grounded_answer
assertions: Every material knowledge claim binds to an eligible source locator and supporting span.
Every material current-fact claim binds to a fresh scoped Observation.
Conflict, expired evidence and unanswerable questions are refused or limited rather than invented.

preserved_public_contract.name: resumable_effect_once_action
assertions: Approval Snapshot and selected revision are immutable audit facts.
Checkpoint resume does not reset Provider or tool budgets.
Idempotent replay, duplicate click and worker takeover produce at most one business effect.

preserved_public_contract.name: fail_closed_real_mode
assertions: Missing Secret, Provider initialization failure, native Tool Calling failure and dependency failure cannot silently select Fake Provider.
Customer-visible failures are typed and redacted.
Failure creates no unauthorized proposal, approval or effect.

preserved_public_contract.name: non_authoritative_memory
assertions: Memory stores bounded sourced history and never grants mutation authority.
Fresh scoped observations supersede older facts.
Current account, subscription, billing, key and incident truth is read from authoritative tools.

preserved_public_contract.name: conversation_and_approver_product_separation
assertions: Customers can continue the conversation while a proposal awaits approval.
Only the approver workspace exposes human decision controls.
Loading, Error and Empty states are distinct and stale responses cannot overwrite newer state.
